attributes.action: Rule out introducing any household levy, or internet tax to fund the BBC
attributes.additional_details: Imposing a mandatory fee on household internet to subsidise the BBC forces citizens to pay for services they do not use. Millions have legally opted out of the TV Licence. Internet access is an essential utility for work and education, not a vehicle to prop up a broadcaster facing serious governance concerns. The Government represents the public and must not impose an unavoidable levy. The BBC should encrypt its services and move to an opt-in subscription.
attributes.background: We call on the UK Government to immediately rule out any plans to replace the TV Licence with a universal levy, internet/broadband surcharge, or council tax addition to fund the BBC, and instead transition the broadcaster to a voluntary subscription model.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. The Government has not announced any plans to introduce an internet levy.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.
